title: P5-01: Papyrus: readerBasePath so the Pretext reader can live under /information
description:
## Goal
Papyrus can serve its Pretext reader (home, dated edition pages, articles, sections, pages, archive, settings) under a configurable public prefix, `/information` for p.apyr.us, with every generated link, canonical redirect and cache revalidation using the prefix. Default (no prefix) behavior is byte-identical for every other site.

## Context (FACT, origin/develop 4541deb)
- No reader base path exists. `getEditionDatePath()` in `lib/edition-routes.ts` returns `/YYYY/<month>/DD`; `getCurrentDatePath()` builds `/${year}/${month}/${day}`; the four `app/[year]/[month]/[day]/**/page.tsx` routes `redirect(route.canonicalPath)`.
- Other hardcoded reader paths: `components/newspaper.tsx:1880` (`/articles/${slug}` fallback), `lib/newspaper-layout.ts:899` and `lib/presentation-footer.ts:46` (`/archive`), `lib/papyrus-web-locations.ts:60,66,219,452` (`/archive`, `/articles/`), `components/settings-page.tsx:117` (`href="/"`), `app/api/revalidate/route.ts:38-48,79` (`revalidatePath` for edition date, `/articles/<slug>`, `/archive`), `lib/archive-data.ts:18`.
- `lib/newsroom-base-path.ts` only supports `/newsroom` or `""` (`toInternalNewsroomPath` does not map a custom prefix to `/newsroom`), so the newsroom stays at `/newsroom` (decision; see Phase ticket).
- `lib/site-brand.ts` has `rootRoute` and `newsroomBasePath` but no reader prefix.

## Exact steps (outside-in BDD)
1. Gherkin first (features/): scenarios "a brand with readerBasePath /information renders edition links under /information", "article, section, page, archive and footer links carry the prefix", "a non-canonical date URL redirects to the prefixed canonical path", "revalidate refreshes prefixed paths", "a brand without readerBasePath is unchanged".
2. Add optional `readerBasePath?: string` (normalized: leading slash, no trailing slash, default `""`) to `SiteBrand`; new `lib/reader-base-path.ts` with `getReaderBasePath()` and `toPublicReaderPath(path)`.
3. Route every hardcoded reader path listed above through `toPublicReaderPath`. `parseEdition*Route` compare against prefixed canonical paths and accept params from the prefixed mount.
4. `settings-page` home link and `app/api/revalidate` use the helper. Do not touch `/newsroom` handling.

## Acceptance checks
- New feature file green; full existing BDD and unit suites green with no snapshot or text changes (default brand).
- With a test brand `readerBasePath: "/information"`: `getEditionDatePath("2026-10-07")` = `/information/2026/october/07`; article, section, page, archive, footer and web-location paths all start with `/information`; no remaining string literal `"/articles` or `"/archive` outside the helper (grep in the PR description).
- `npm run typecheck` and lint clean.

## Rollback
Revert the PR; the field is optional and absent everywhere else.

## Risks
Missed hardcoded link (grep and the footer/masthead component tests cover it); search for template literals starting with a slash in `components/` and `lib/`.

## Needs Ryan
PR merge into develop only.
